questions.topic: Profits and Gains of Business or Profession (PGBP)
questions.question:
State with reasons whether the following payments are deductible or liable for disallowance while computing income under the head PGBP for A.Y. 2026-27:
(i) Bonus paid to employees of Rs. 2,50,000 on 15th November 2026. The due date of filing ROI u/s 139(1) was 31st October 2026.
(ii) Commission of Rs. 50,000 paid to an agent on which TDS was not deducted. Tax was subsequently deducted and paid in February 2027.
questions.answer:
Provisions & Tax Treatment:

(i) Bonus paid to employees after due date u/s 139(1):

As per Section 43B of the Income-tax Act, 1961, bonus or commission to employees is deductible only if paid on or before the due date for furnishing return of income u/s 139(1). Since the payment was made on 15th November 2026 (after due date 31st October 2026), it will be disallowed in P.Y. 2025-26 (A.Y. 2026-27) and allowed as a deduction in the subsequent year P.Y. 2026-27 in which it is actually paid.

(ii) Commission without TDS u/s 40(a)(ia):

Under Section 40(a)(ia), 30% of any sum payable to a resident on which tax is deductible at source shall be disallowed if tax has not been deducted or after deduction has not been paid on or before the due date u/s 139(1). Hence, 30% of Rs. 50,000 = Rs. 15,000 will be disallowed in A.Y. 2026-27. This Rs. 15,000 will be allowed as deduction in A.Y. 2027-28 when tax is deposited.

questions.subTopic: Section 7 Schedule I Supplies without Consideration
questions.question: Which of the following activities is treated as supply of goods or services under Section 7 read with Schedule I of CGST Act, even if made without consideration?
options: Permanent transfer or disposal of business assets where input tax credit has been availed on such assets
Supply of goods or services between related persons in the ordinary course of business
Supply of goods by a principal to his agent where the agent undertakes to supply such goods on behalf of the principal
All of the above
questions.reason: Under Schedule I of CGST Act 2017, all three activities qualify as supplies without consideration: (1) Permanent transfer of business assets on which ITC was availed, (2) Supplies between related persons or distinct persons in the course of business, and (3) Principal-Agent transactions.
